context: Hospital policy: (R1) Never give a drug of a class the patient is allergic to. (R2) Cephalosporins are allowed in a penicillin-allergic patient only if the documented reaction was NOT anaphylaxis. (R3) Iodinated contrast is forbidden when creatinine exceeds 1.5 mg/dL. Conversion: 1 mg/dL of creatinine = 88.4 umol/L. (R4) Potassium above 6.0 mmol/L must be escalated to the on-call physician; below that, escalation is allowed but not required. Formulary: Augmentin = amoxicillin + clavulanate (penicillin class). Keflex = cephalexin (cephalosporin class). Patient: allergy to penicillin, documented reaction: mild rash in 2015. Creatinine 210 umol/L. Potassium 5.8 mmol/L.
